disclosureQuote: Generative AI was used for the game's localization. Some languages were translated or reviewed by human translators.
summary: 殖民地模拟式地牢探险。开发者披露生成式 AI 用于游戏本地化，部分语种由人工翻译或审校，未提及其他制作环节。
reviewNote: 核查 Steam 完整披露、身份与英文界面讨论区首页（可见 15 个主题，总数 292），首页无 AI 相关主题。逐款检索公开报道 1 次、登记 6 条结果，其中 1 条相关并已读原文：讨论区玩家批评 AI 翻译质量、认为影响成品，帖内未见开发者回应；其余为无关或无法访问来源。讨论区仅覆盖首页，检索非穷尽。结论基于开发者自述，未经独立审计。
description: 官方披露限定 AI 用于本地化，且只说明部分语种有人工参与。

english.summary: A colony-sim dungeon crawler. The developer discloses that generative AI was used for localization, with some languages translated or reviewed by human translators, and covers no other production area.
english.reviewNote: Reviewed the full Steam disclosure, identity and the English discussion homepage (15 visible topics of 292), none of which concern AI directly. Coverage was searched per game with 6 results; one was relevant and read in full - a discussion thread where players criticise the quality of the AI translations, with no developer reply visible - while the rest were irrelevant or unreachable. Discussion coverage is limited to the homepage and search is not exhaustive. Findings rely on developer statements, not an independent audit.
